title: Dash Lockfile
description: Schema for dash.lock — the generated, deterministic lockfile that pins every resolved dependency to its content ID (CID), making a build a pure function of the lockfile contents. This file is machine-generated; do not edit by hand.

version.description: Lockfile format version. Currently 1. Incremented only on backward-incompatible format changes.

root.description: Root package reference in the format name@version. Identifies the root of the dependency graph.

lockDigest.description: BLAKE3 digest (self-verifying) over the canonical TOML content of this lockfile. Enables offline verification that the lockfile hasn't been tampered with. Format: 'b3:' prefix followed by base32-encoded 256-bit hash.

package.title: Resolved Packages
package.description: List of every resolved package in the dependency graph. Ordered deterministically (sorted by name then version) for merge-friendly diffs.

items.title: Lockfile Package Entry
items.description: A single resolved package in the lockfile. Records the exact version, content ID, provenance, and granted capabilities.

name.description: Package name. Matches the name in dash.toml.

version.description: The exact resolved semver version. This is documentation; the CID is the true identity.

cid.description: Content ID (BLAKE3 CID) of the capsule — the immutable artifact identity. Two packages with the same CID are byte-identical capsules.

resolved-from.description: The version range in the manifest that selected this version via MVS. Documents why this version was chosen.

registry.description: Registry URL from which this package was resolved and fetched.

provenance.title: Provenance Record
provenance.description: Transparency log provenance linking this pinned version to a logged publish event. Enables offline verification of legitimate publication.

logIndex.description: Index position in the global transparency log for this publish event.

slsaLevel.description: SLSA attestation level (1–4). Higher levels indicate stronger supply-chain security guarantees.

publisher.description: Decentralized identifier (DID) of the publisher identity.

capabilities.title: Granted Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capability grants this package actually received at resolution time. The intersection of what the package requested and what the consumer's policy allowed.

net.description: Granted network egress capability with allowlist.

fs-read.description: Granted filesystem read capability with path allowlist.

fs-write.description: Granted filesystem write capability with path allowlist.

env.description: Granted environment variable access with named variable allowlist.

build.title: Build Entry
build.description: Build metadata present only for packages with a declarative build step. Records the tool used and the output content ID.

tool.description: Pinned builder tool reference used to produce the build outputs.

outputCid.description: Content ID of the build output capsule.

hermetic.description: Whether the build was hermetic (no network access, no ambient filesystem).

graph.title: Dependency Graph Adjacency
graph.description: Adjacency list mapping each package reference (name@version) to its array of direct dependency references. Sorted for deterministic, merge-friendly output. Enables fast, reproducible install without re-resolving.

additionalProperties.description: List of direct dependencies for this package.
